goal: Continue PA-BPE cross-domain multilingual tokenization fairness research by applying the frozen contamination protocol to eligible Tatoeba triangles and independently verifying the deterministic development selection before tokenizer scoring

completion_criteria.description: Compare Classical BPE, PA-BPE variants and a simple data-balancing control on frozen aligned development and unseen-domain evaluation data with independently verified fairness and total-cost metrics
Determine whether fairness gains persist across domains and test one evidence-derived repair if a failure mechanism is observed, retaining negative results
